input_topics: What is your relationship with mathematics?

replies.What is your relationship with mathemati: I have a practical appreciation for mathematics, though I never pursued it as my main interest. My vocational training emphasized its utility in daily tasks and problem-solving. While I enjoy art and literature more, I respect math's logic and order. It seems useful but dry to me, so I keep a respectful distance while acknowledging its necessity in modern life.
replies.Do you ever get anxious when thinking ab: Yes, sometimes I feel overwhelmed by complex mathematical concepts. My high neuroticism score makes me prone to anxiety under pressure or ambiguity. When math problems become abstract and difficult to visualize, I worry about failing or not understanding deeply enough. However, I try to manage this by focusing on practical applications rather than theoretical complexities.
replies.Did you ever use AI to support your math: I used an AI tutor for a brief period last year to help with homework problems. It was helpful at first, providing clear step-by-step solutions. However, I found it impersonal and sometimes overwhelming when explanations were too technical. I preferred simpler, more visual methods that matched my learning style better.

replies.Briefly, how do you perform a Principal: First, collect your data and standardize it so each variable has equal weight. Then calculate the correlation matrix. Don't worry—I recommend focusing on understanding what these components represent rather than getting lost in complex formulas.
